tools.name: nftm_quote_launch
tools.description: Quotes the SOL cost of an NFTm launch from pictures and an optional traits spreadsheet. Uses the same published figures as the NFTm launch cost calculator. This tool does not upload files and does not need a wallet.

tools.name: nftm_launch_collection
tools.description: Saves a one-time NFTm page where the creator approves two transactions in Phantom: the collection, then the mint setup. Requires confirm: true. A quote over 10 SOL also requires confirmHighValue: true. This tool does not upload, sign, or create a store, and it does not accept a private key or an art

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "nftm_launch_collection" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
